panels.sample_scope: Fig. 8 | Departure-aligned energy storage, conversion and layer inputs. a–c, Horizontal kinetic energy, dry available potential energy and same-window APE-to-KE conversion at 700 hPa. d–f, Contributions of kinetic, available-potential and pressure fluxes to net vertical input across the 500–850 hPa layer boundaries. Upper traces show paired-sample temporary- and final-departure means at each available relative time. Lower traces show the directly paired temporary-minus-final difference with pointwise 95% SID-bootstrap intervals; the separate diamond labelled Pre shows the fixed pre-departure contrast over at least three identical offsets among −24, −18, −12 and −6 h. All panels use the nominal 2–16-day window and the 0–300 km region. The time-specific paired sample can change as observations end; complete sample counts and all six original primary-family tests are retained in Tables S7a,j,k. Intervals concern paired differences, not individual-event means. Storage and conversion refer to the 700-hPa scale-window fields; layer inputs measure energy exchange through the two pressure boundaries.
